original_skeleton: Nonnegative heights and smaller width → bound → every retained-left candidate.

source_quotes.quote: Its width k - left is smaller, and its water height cannot exceed height[left], even if the new wall is much taller. Because heights are nonnegative,
area(left, k) <= (k - left) * height[left] <= (right - left) * height[left].

finding: 骨架留下 nonnegative 與 smaller width，卻沒有保留這是 shorter-left 分支。原式最後一項之所以是已量到的 endpoint area，依賴 height[left] <= height[right]。省略它後，骨架只說 retained-left candidate 受界，沒有交代是以哪個已記錄值作界；若按章節用途反向展開為「每個較窄的 retained-left pair 都不超過剛量的 endpoint area」，條件就不足。
source_bound_countercheck: P14 明寫 right 較短時要保留 right 作同一個界並減少 right；P15 的 taller-wall 反例證明不能把任一端點當成可排除端點。這裡不以正文前段默補被骨架省去的必要條件。

original_skeleton: The recorded endpoint area → bounds → every remaining candidate involving left.

source_quotes.quote: So no such pair can beat the endpoint area we already recorded.
Every remaining candidate involving left can be discarded together by increasing left by one.
Always moving the taller wall lacks that proof.

finding: 骨架把帶有 such pair 前文限定的結論，改成 recorded endpoint area 對所有 remaining candidate involving left 的無條件界。left 必須是較短或等高端點才有這個結論。正文與 Active A0004 保留 P11/P12 的條件，無法替這筆骨架消除條件遺失。
source_bound_countercheck: 只把 left 從 shorter 改成 taller，就離開 P11 證明分支；P14 指定此時要反向處理，P15 另給 taller-wall 路徑漏掉 optimum 的完整反例。

original_skeleton: Retaining legal completions → produces → one valid order without a smallest-first guarantee.

source_quotes.quote: Return order if its length equals V, otherwise return [].
Each retained entry records a legal completion, so the earlier proof establishes the returned ordering.
On failure, the partial order is temporary auxiliary storage of at most V entries and the returned empty list has constant size.

finding: 保留每一次合法完成，只能保證保留下來的 entries 各自合法；產生可回傳的完整 course order 還需要 length == V。骨架省略成功條件與失敗分支，因此把可能只有 partial order 的狀態寫成會產生 one valid order。
source_bound_countercheck: P17 本文拒絕案例只完成 course 2，finished = 1，與 3 比較後回傳 False；依 P33 的改版，所保留的單一合法完成不能成為三門課的完整 order。P34 明確把 failure 的 partial order 記作 temporary auxiliary storage。
